# NotificationCentre

The sheet listing everything waiting, with a way to clear it.

## Anatomy

A `Sheet` whose action slot holds the clear-all, and whose body is either an `EmptyState` or a stack of `Toast`s.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `open` | `boolean` | `$bindable(false)` | — |
| `title` *(required)* | `string` | — | "3 items" or "All clear", already interpolated by the caller. |
| `eyebrow` | `string` | `'Notifications'` | — |
| `empty` | `boolean` | `false` | True when there is nothing waiting, so the empty state shows instead of the list. |
| `emptyTitle` *(required)* | `string` | — | — |
| `emptyHint` | `string` | `''` | — |
| `clearLabel` | `string` | `'Clear all'` | — |
| `onclear` | `() => void` | — | — |
| `onclose` | `() => void` | — | — |
| `children` | `Snippet` | — | — |

## Variants

Populated and empty.

## States

Open, closed, empty.

Every value resolves through a semantic or component token; `scripts/check-fidelity.mjs` fails on a literal.

## Keyboard

Inherited from `Sheet`: focus is trapped while open, `Escape` closes, focus returns to the bell.

## ARIA

Inherited from `Sheet`. The title is the caller's already-interpolated summary — "3 items" or "All clear" — so the count is announced when the sheet opens.

## Accessibility acceptance criteria

- Reachable, operable and leavable by keyboard alone, with a focus indicator meeting 3:1 in both schemes.
- An accessible name for every control, and current state exposed programmatically.
- No meaning carried by colour alone.
- Legible and operable at a 360px viewport and at desktop width, and at 200% zoom.
- Interactive targets at least 44 × 44px on touch-capable viewports.
